nodes.title: 女主播二采
widgets_values:
A single continuous ten-second live-action broadcast shot. Cinematic live-action news-studio style, a medium shot frames a young East Asian female news anchor seated behind a glass news desk; cool blue light washes the glowing studio monitors behind her while a soft frontal fill light shapes her face.

A young East Asian woman with long wavy dark-brown hair falling past her shoulders and softly curled at the ends sits centered behind the desk. She wears a white lace halter-neck dress with a sheer embroidered yoke and a deep V neckline; her makeup is clean and natural with defined brows and soft pink lips. Her shoulders stay square to the camera and her hands rest lightly on the glass desktop.

The set stays fixed around her: a low glass news desk with a small black gooseneck microphone in front of her, a large glowing blue video wall of studio monitors behind, broadcast cameras and dark studio rigging along the edges — the desk, the microphone, the monitors and the rigging remain stationary throughout.

She looks straight into the lens and breaks into a warm, welcoming smile, then speaks to the audience in a bright, cheerful, conversational tone. She reads her lines aloud in Chinese, her voice clear, upbeat and friendly: "兄弟们好啊，周末愉快。" She gives a small nod and lifts her eyebrows with a playful, curious look as she asks in Chinese, her voice light and teasing: "凡人修仙传看了吗？" Her eyes widen with genuine delight and she leans slightly forward toward the camera as she says in Chinese, her voice warm and emphatic: "好好看呀。" She settles back with a bright smile while the quiet studio room tone continues around her, and the camera holds a static framing with only a barely perceptible slow push-in. No pull-back; the only camera move is the continuous, almost imperceptible push-in.

Throughout the shot the studio stays quiet: a faint air-conditioning hum sits under soft paper rustling on the glass desk, and her chair creaks gently once when she leans forward. No background music plays.

nodes.title: 红发一采
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Epic stylized 3D animated cinematic, a low-angle hero shot frames the red-haired swordsman exactly as shown in <Picture 1> — a ruggedly handsome samurai with windswept crimson-red hair, a short dark goatee, and piercing intense eyes, wearing an open black coat with deep crimson lining over a bare chest, gripping an ornate katana with a golden round tsuba, the polished blade thrust diagonally toward the lens in forced perspective. Behind him stretch snow-covered mountain peaks under a vivid blue sky with scattered white clouds, and thick snowflakes drift and swirl through the air. He holds the pose for a beat as the wind picks up, his long coat and red hair rippling while heavy snow sweeps across the frame in horizontal streaks. He narrows his eyes with a fearless half-smile and slowly rotates his wrist, the blade catching a bright glint of sunlight as more snow spirals around him. The camera pushes in slowly and drifts a few degrees sideways in elegant slow motion, keeping him centered against the mountains. In the final seconds he shifts his weight into a draw stance and releases one lightning-fast diagonal slash, snapping a fan of powder snow off the blade, then freezes with the katana angled past the lens, snowburst hanging in the air around him.

overall_soundscape: Howling alpine wind rising and falling, the hiss of snow sweeping past the camera, a sharp metallic ring as the blade glints, and a crisp whip-crack whoosh on the final slash, with crunching snow underfoot as he shifts his stance.

non_diegetic_music: Epic orchestral score with taiko drums and deep brass, building slowly and hitting a single massive hit synchronized with the final slash, then cutting to silence.

nodes.title: 红发2采
widgets_values:
A ten-second cinematic live-action epic. Wide anamorphic framing of an endless snowfield sloping toward a pale frozen horizon under a low winter sky, shot on 35mm feature film with shallow depth of field, a cool blue-grey colour grade and fine film grain. Powder snow drifts in the air and a soft rim light traces the horizon; the frame stays clean and uncluttered with no other figures present.

A tall young swordsman stands alone in the middle distance. His deep crimson hair is tied back into a low, messily tied ponytail with a few loose strands escaped at the nape. A jagged pale scar cuts across his left cheekbone. He wears ink-black leather wrist cuffs studded with silver, a weathered dark leather haori worn over lacquered black shoulder plates, and a long katana hangs at his hip with the blade un-drawn.

The location stays fixed around him: bare rocks scattered across the snow, tall grass stems poking through the drift and wind-carved ridges on the frozen horizon. Everything but the falling snow and the wind remains stationary throughout.

He holds a still stance with his head tilted slightly into the wind and lets out a slow breath that hangs in the freezing air. The only sound is the high, thin hiss of falling powder snow filling the air.

A hard cut transitions to the same snowfield, now swept by a gust; the powder snow lifts into a driving veil that streaks past the lens, his haori snaps taut against his arms and the low wind drone keeps running under the shot. He turns his wrist once, and a blade of pale light cuts across his face for a single frame before the snow haze closes over it again.

A hard cut transitions to a slow lateral push that drifts sideways across the snowfield as he draws the katana in one clean arc. The blade edge throws a sheet of pale light ahead of it, the wind swells and the low drone of the gale continues without interruption.

A hard cut transitions to the final beat: he releases the katana and slashes downward in a steep diagonal, and a fan-shaped burst of powder snow erupts outward from the blade. He holds that frozen stance as the snowburst still hangs in the cold air.

Through the whole shot the only sounds are the gale, the dry crack of snow crystals and the fine hiss of the falling snow. No background music plays; the wind score stays absent until the last frame.

Cinematic live-action epic look: 35mm anamorphic wide framing, shallow depth of field, cool blue-grey colour grade, fine film grain, clean fashion-campaign composition, smooth hard cuts between the shots.

## H3 二采放大 → LTX-2.5 三步精修 · 这个工作流干嘛的

已有 H3 二采 latent → latent 空间放大 → H3LTXAdapter 转格式 → LTX-2.5 22B distilled 三步精修 → 出视频。

---

## 一、用到哪些模型 / 放哪个文件夹

第一段：H3 段

| 文件 | 放在 |
| --- | --- |
| minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors | models/diffusion_models |
| qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors | models/text_encoders |
| minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors | models/vae |
| minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors | models/vae |
| minimax_h3_taomate_3step_lora_avg_rank_19_bf16.safetensors | models/loras |
| model.safetensors | models/h3_ltx_adapter |
| minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors | models/latent_upscale_models |

第二段：LTX-2.5 三步精修

| 文件 | 放在 |
| --- | --- |
| ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors | models/diffusion_models |
| gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors | models/text_encoders |
| ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors | models/vae |
| ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors | models/vae |

注：h3_ltx_adapter 是 XH 节点自注册的目录，ComfyUI 不会自动建，要手动建。

---

## 二、用到哪些节点包

| 包 | 用到的节点 |
| --- | --- |
| Comfyui-XH_Toolbox | H3LTXAdapterLoader、H3LTXAdapterConvert、XHGroupController、XHTimer |
| comfyui-kjnodes | MiniMaxChunkFeedForward、LTXVChunkFeedForward、LTX2AttentionTunerPatch |
| Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler | MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D |
| comfyui_nvidia_rtx_nodes | RTXVideoSuperResolution |

全部丢进 ComfyUI/custom_nodes，重启生效，不需要额外装模型。

其余节点全是官方内置，位置：

- comfy_extras/nodes_minimax_h3.py → MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo、MiniMaxH3SigmaShift
- comfy_extras/nodes_lt.py → LTXVConditioning、LTXVPreprocess、LTXVImgToVideoInplace、LTXVSeparateAVLatent、LTXVConcatAVLatent、LTXVDualCFGGuider
- comfy_extras/nodes_lt_audio.py → LTXVAudioVAEEncode、LTXVAudioVAEDecode
- comfy_extras/nodes_lt_upsampler.py → LTXVLatentUpsampler
- comfy_extras/nodes_sparse_attention.py → BlockSparseAttention
- comfy_extras/nodes_model_advanced.py → ModelAttentionBackend
- comfy_extras/nodes_custom_sampler.py → ManualSigmas
- comfy_extras/nodes_video.py → SaveVideo、CreateVideo、LoadVideo、GetVideoComponents
- comfy_extras/nodes_preview_any.py → PreviewAny
- comfy_extras/nodes_resolution.py → ResolutionSelector
- comfy_extras/nodes_primitive.py → PrimitiveStringMultiline、PrimitiveFloat
- comfy_extras/nodes_math.py → ComfyMathExpression
- comfy_extras/nodes_post_processing.py → ResizeImageMaskNode
